name: Harvesting the Harvesters
summary: A salvaged harvester part may interest someone who studies harvest golems. You are asked to bring it to Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm.

sections.title: A Salvaged Part
sections.body: Someone at Saldean's Farm may want to examine the part you salvaged from a harvester. It appears mostly intact, and Ozwin Ironsprocket is waiting to see it.

faq.q: What do I take to Ozwin?
faq.answer: You bring Ozwin Ironsprocket the Precessive Autocognition Assembly, a part salvaged from a harvester.

faq.q: Where do I bring the salvaged part?
faq.answer: Bring the Precessive Autocognition Assembly to Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm.

faq.q: Why might someone want the part?
faq.answer: The salvaged part appears mostly intact, and someone interested in harvest golems may want to see it.
